query: INSERT INTO msg_event_type_spec_versions (id, event_type_id, version, mime_type, schema_content, schema_type, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, event_type_id, '1.0', 'application/schema+json', schema_content, $5, $6, $4, $4 FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::jsonb[]) AS v(id, event_type_id, schema_content) ON CONFLICT (event_type_id, version) DO NOTHING
